description: Notion is a workspace app for notes, docs, wikis, and databases, with an API for reading and writing pages, databases, and blocks.
access_notes: Internal integrations and personal access tokens are created self-serve and free in the developer portal, working immediately. Caveat: on Business and Enterprise plans, PAT/integration creation is disabled by default and a workspace owner must enable it in Settings -> Connections first, which makes access effectively ADMIN_GATED for those specific workspaces.
api_notes: Covers pages, databases, blocks, users, comments, and search -- the full content model of the product, but a narrower object surface than a platform like Salesforce or Stripe. Classified MODERATE rather than BROAD on that comparative basis.
